key_insight: Q-Drive combines variational quantum circuits with classical optimization to control nonlinear vehicle dynamics while reporting substantially lower control effort than classical baselines.
engineering_relevance: The framework targets energy-efficient vehicle and fleet control, with conditional stability guarantees accounting for road disturbances and quantum decoherence.
method: Encode vehicle states into quantum circuits using angle embedding.
Generate control signals with a trainable quantum ansatz optimized by gradient descent.
Analyze stability using a composite Lyapunov function combining tracking dynamics and quantum-state purity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports orders-of-magnitude lower single-vehicle control effort versus MPC and LQR, and over 60% lower average per-vehicle effort as decoupled fleet size increases from 2 to 50.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish real-hardware performance or matched tracking accuracy across baselines; decoupled fleet results may not extend to interacting traffic.
paper_title: $Q$-Drive: A Hybrid Quantum-Classical Control Framework for Nonlinear Vehicular Dynamics
